description: Standard user role with read-only access
Administrator role with full management capabilities
Default viewer role for Domain Map
Default manager role for Domain Map

Owns candidate sourcing, screening, and pipeline progression for assigned requisitions. Coordinates interviews and extends offers. Permission bundle uses `:manage` tier on primary modules plus specific lifecycle gates the IC workflow needs (approve_requisition, approve_offer).

Owns the requisition, sets job criteria, evaluates candidates, makes final hiring decisions. Every line manager in every function does this role — `business_function_id` is NULL per plan-roles.md §7 Q2.
Owns logistics — interview scheduling, candidate communications, scorecard collection, background-check kickoff.
Owns talent-pool management, proactive candidate outreach, and pipeline seeding ahead of formal requisition opening.

Manages a recruiter team. No role-level inheritance from Recruiter (plan-roles.md §7 Q3) — uses `:admin` permission tier across the modules they oversee, and Semantius's permission_hierarchy auto-includes the underlying `:manage` / `:read` / lifecycle-gate permissions.
Operates onboarding journeys day-to-day: schedules tasks, nudges blocked items, coordinates buddies and welcome cadences.
Owns new-hire paperwork: I-9, tax forms, NDA, direct-deposit. Approves and archives document collections; supports journey execution.
Owns the onboarding program: plan templates, welcome strategy, cohort design, and time-to-productivity metrics.

Owns named opportunities through close. Drives opportunity progression, manages account relationships on assigned accounts, and logs every customer-facing activity. Permission bundle uses :manage on PIPELINE-MGT and ACTIVITY (primary), :read on ACCT-MGT and LEAD-MGT (secondary), plus the close_won gate.
Owner-operator of the farm; admin-tier across the entire FDS surface. The single-user / small-team default in early-stage deployments.

Prospects and qualifies inbound and outbound leads, books meetings, and hands warm opportunities to AEs. Lives in LEAD-MGT and ACTIVITY day-to-day. Permission bundle uses :manage on LEAD-MGT and ACTIVITY (primary), :read on ACCT-MGT and PIPELINE-MGT (secondary), plus the convert_lead gate.

Manages a team of AEs and SDRs. Approves forecasts, reviews pipeline health, and intervenes on at-risk deals. Permission bundle uses :admin on every operational CRM module to inherit all workflow gates via permission_hierarchy, plus :manage on AI-COPILOT.

Configures CRM workflows, pipeline-stage definitions, lead routing rules, and the AI copilot. Owns the system's reference data and integration glue. Permission bundle uses :admin on AI-COPILOT (primary, owns the automation surface) and ACCT-MGT (primary, owns segments and territories), plus :manage on PIPELINE-MGT, LEAD-MGT, and ACTIVITY for ongoing reference-data edits.
Full administrative access across the HCM stack. Owns configuration, security, and workflow routing for the worker record, org design, and the self-service surface.

Day-to-day HR operations: process new hires, lifecycle events, contract changes, and offboarding. Manages the worker record and runs the lifecycle workflow surface for cases that need HR intervention.

Business-aligned HR partner advising leaders on workforce decisions. Has manage rights on the worker record for their scope, reads org and lifecycle data to inform manager coaching, and approves employment events for their client group.

Manages the org structure: designs org units, approves positions, owns job-profile catalog, and supports workforce planning cycles. Reads the worker record for incumbency context but does not edit it.

Cross-functional line manager. Reads their team's worker data, raises and approves manager-initiated changes through the self-service surface, and reviews position incumbency. Not HR; lives in any business function.
Runs the talent-management program end-to-end: review cycle cadence, calibration sessions, succession bench, and continuous-feedback adoption. Owns the program across all three modules.
Owns inventory operations end-to-end for the warehouse: full administrative access to stock tracking, replenishment, and kitting. Approves cycle-count variances, transfers, and exceptional movements.
Authors and tunes reorder rules, ABC-XYZ classifications, and ATP policy. Reads stock balances to validate replenishment decisions; does not touch kit definitions.
Read-only access to stock and replenishment data for inventory valuation, COGS calculation, and variance reporting. Writes happen in ERP-FIN, not in INV-MGMT.
Owns the ITAM umbrella across normalization, contracts, lifecycle, and portfolio reporting. Admin tier on every umbrella module.
Authors, activates, renews, and terminates asset support/maintenance contracts. Reads lifecycle events and portfolio reporting for context.
Records lifecycle events (procurement, deployment, transfer, retirement, disposal) and maintains the cross-asset normalization catalog.
Analyses IT total cost of ownership and asset-contract commitments from a Finance perspective. Read-only on ITAM modules.
Authors part designs, mints engineering revisions, owns CAD source files in the vault, and writes / decomposes engineering requirements. The originator of most ECRs.
Authors the mBOM, manufacturing routing, and work-instruction structure. Bridges engineering release to MES; the typical releaser of mBOM and routing revisions.
Owns the engineering change workflow end-to-end: impact analysis, CAB submission, approval routing, release scheduling, and close-out. Cross-cuts engineering, manufacturing, and compliance.

Owns product-compliance declarations end-to-end: maintains the regulated-substances catalog, requests declarations from suppliers, approves received declarations, and gates the sellable-in-market flag.
L&D leader who owns the course catalog and the skills/learning-path program. Full admin on course delivery and skills modules; visibility into compliance training.
L&D individual contributor who authors courses and curates learning paths. Manage rights on course delivery, manage on skills (path curation), no compliance gates.
GRC owner of mandatory regulatory training programs (harassment, HIPAA, OSHA, anti-bribery, SOX). Full admin on compliance training; read on course catalog to verify content fulfills assignments.
Cross-functional people-manager persona: any line manager who assigns and tracks learning progress for direct reports. Read across all LMS modules; no module-admin rights.

Authors workforce plans, headcount plans, and skills-gap analyses. Maintains the demand-supply reconciliation cycle. Permission bundle uses `:manage` on primary modules plus the workforce-plan and headcount approval gates.
Owns the SWP function. Final approver on workforce plans, scenarios, and org designs. Permission bundle is `:admin` across all four modules; `permission_hierarchy` auto-includes every workflow gate.
FP&A counterpart for workforce costs. Owns workforce_cost_projections approval and the EPM handoff. Reads demand and scenarios to validate cost build-up.
Specialist who authors and iterates org_designs. Works closely with scenarios and the labor-market overlay.
Executive sponsor (CHRO / CFO / business-unit head) who reviews and adopts workforce plans, scenarios, and cost projections. Cross-functional role; not tied to a single business function.
Owns the workplace experience across reservations, service requests, and space analytics. Admin-tier on most IWMS modules.
Owns space planning, occupancy analytics, and scenario modelling. Admin-tier on analytics; manage-tier on the location master; read on reservation modules for upstream visibility.
Day-to-day workplace operations IC: triages service requests, oversees reservation policies, fields workplace-experience issues.
Cross-functional self-service persona: any employee who books desks, reserves rooms, submits service requests, or gives workplace feedback.

Cross-functional architect who owns the business capability map, the reference framework library, and the technology-fit methodology. Spans the registry seat (publishes the capability map) and the rationalization seat (approves fit assessments).
Owns a specific enterprise application's portfolio metadata: lifecycle stage, interfaces, technology platform, cost data. Primary on the registry; reads scoring data from rationalization.
Runs the portfolio rationalization cycle: TIME-scoring, sunset decisions, cost-visibility reporting to leadership. Admin-tier across both modules; expands permission_hierarchy at request time.
Owns the CMDB end-to-end: discovery configuration, CI class authoring, service-mapping policy, baseline strategy, and stewardship workflows. Full admin on every CMDB module.
Runs discovery scans, triages reconciliation conflicts, and curates the service maps generated from discovery output. Manage on CMDB-CORE and CMDB-SERVICE-MAPPING.

Owns CI class definitions, data-quality KPIs, and baseline review for a specific CI domain (servers, network, database). Manage on CMDB-CORE; manage on baselines to capture/promote stewardship snapshots.
Senior operator in the Executive Office responsible for end-to-end strategy execution: cascading corporate objectives, tracking initiatives, and orchestrating operating cadences.
Analyst supporting the Chief of Staff: maintains strategy maps and OKR cascades, builds initiative dashboards, prepares operating-review materials.

Department or business-unit head accountable for cascaded objectives and owned initiatives. Touches strategy-definition (owns objectives), execution-tracking (owns initiatives), and operating-rhythm (participates in QBRs). Cross-functional: business_function_id is NULL.
IC who works customer cases end-to-end: capture, triage, respond, resolve, request CSAT. Operates the case workflow and consumes entitlements / knowledge.
Manages the case workflow at the team level: assignment overrides, escalation, SLA breach handling, supervisor-tier CSAT detractor follow-up.
Configures every CSM module: case taxonomies, SLA definitions, entitlement catalogs, knowledge base structure. Admin-tier on every CSM module.

Customer Success motion. Reads cases / CSAT / entitlements to drive account health, expansion, and renewal. Read-only on case-mgmt; manage on entitlements; primarily consumes via the Customer Success function.

End-User Computing operator responsible for the workstream collaboration platform: channel/workspace administration, retention policy, huddle settings, and external guest governance across all three WSC modules.

Owns external guest lifecycle for the workstream collaboration platform: invitations, access scoping into channels, and revocation on offboarding. Distinct from the broader platform admin role: focused on the partner/vendor/customer surface, not on channel administration.

Cross-functional end-user persona for the workstream collaboration platform. Every employee with a license does this role: post messages, join channels, start/join huddles, attach files, manage own status. No admin tier and no external-guest workflow.

Full administrative authority across plan design, enrollment, carrier integration, and ACA compliance. Owns the benefits program end to end: plan catalog, OE-window operations, carrier relationships, compliance filings.
Owns the plan catalog and carrier relationships: designs benefit offerings, attaches carriers, negotiates renewals, schedules open-enrollment windows. Does not run the enrollment workflow itself.
Runs the enrollment workflow day to day: processes elections, verifies dependents, reviews and approves life events. Reads the plan catalog but does not change it.
Owns ACA compliance: assembles 1094-C / 1095-C forms, runs affordability analysis, files annual returns. Reads enrollment and plan data but does not modify them.

Tier-1 HR case handler. Owns case triage, assignment, response drafting, and resolution within SLA. Coordinates with HRBPs on sensitive cases. Uses :manage on case mgmt plus specific lifecycle gates (triage, resolve); read on portal and knowledge.

Runs the HR Service Delivery operation: case-routing rules, SLA configuration, agent assignment policy, escalation pathways. Uses :admin on case mgmt; :manage on portal and knowledge. Permission hierarchy auto-includes all lower tiers and lifecycle gates.

Owns the HR knowledge base: authoring pipeline, review workflow, publication, retirement. Reads case closures to spot authoring gaps. Uses :admin on knowledge; :read on case mgmt for closure-pattern analysis.

Owns engagement delivery end to end: project scoping, plan, tasks, milestones, customer-accepted completion. Reads project financials to monitor margin and rev-rec but does not run the finance workflow.
Owns the resource pool, skills inventory, allocation forecasts and project assignments. Watches utilisation and conflict signals. Reads project delivery state to align supply with demand.
Owns project financials: billing rate cards, contractual milestones, invoice triggering, ASC 606 revenue recognition. Reads project delivery and time/expense rollups to gate billing.
Delivery resource on projects: logs time and expenses against assigned project codes, updates task status, contributes to milestone completion. Reads own assignments and project context.

Customer-side or internal business owner of a project's outcomes. Approves customer-accept signoff on delivery completion and milestone reached events. Does not run delivery or finance day to day. Cross-functional: this role sits outside the services-delivery org.
Runs the CSA subscription program day-to-day: member acquisition, share-pack composition, member-facing portal, harvest-forecast integration. Cross-cuts CSA + Harvest Planning + Online Store.
Manages B2B accounts (restaurants, food hubs), wholesale catalog and pricing, order confirmation, and food-hub aggregation.
Plans and dispatches delivery routes, coordinates drivers, owns pickup-location operations.
Stall-side cashier at farmers markets; reads catalog from online store, rings sales, reconciles day.

Day-to-day operator of the contract repository, obligations register, and renewal queue. Drafts contracts from templates, persists executed contracts, tracks obligations, and surfaces renewals for review.
Manager of the contract operations function. Full admin on repository, obligations, and renewal; final approver for high-value contracts. Owns SLAs on obligation closure and renewal cycles.
In-house attorney with final authority on contract approval and clause-library curation. Drives negotiation, approves clauses and templates, owns redline workflow.
Procurement-side counterpart to legal counsel for supplier contracts. Drives commercial negotiation, requests legal approvals, finalizes terms with suppliers.
Sales-side counterpart driving customer-contract authoring from quote-to-signature. Initiates contracts from CPQ-approved quotes, hands negotiation to legal, monitors signature status.

Cross-module administrator for the PIM rollout. Owns module provisioning, attribute-schema evolution, channel configuration, credential rotation, and emergency interventions across all three PIM modules.

Owns merchandising decisions across content and syndication: which products go live, on which channels, with which translations approved. Approves publish gates and drives the prioritization of catalog work.
Application owner / line-of-business approver. Approves or rejects access requests for their entitlements; reads entitlement catalog and the SoD rule output.
Day-to-day content author working across product attributes, descriptions, variants, translations, and the assets attached to them. Submits work for review; rarely owns the approve gate.
Operates the channel-syndication pipelines: queues publish runs, triages rejected listings, monitors job health, and coordinates remediation with Product Content Editors when validation fails.

Procurement-anchored role bridging supplier-onboarding flows into PIM. Ingests supplier data sheets, maps supplier vocabularies to internal attributes, and submits supplier-sourced content for merchandising review.

Practices law on assigned matters. Owns the matter's substantive direction, drafts pleadings, conducts negotiations, captures time, reviews prebills for assigned matters. `:manage` tier on primary modules; specific workflow gates for opening matters and signing engagement letters as billing partner.

Supports attorneys on assigned matters. Drafts court filings, manages docket and key-date calendar, captures party data at intake, organizes matter documents. `:manage` tier on operational modules but no workflow-gate approvals.

Owns IOLTA trust accounting and AR operations at the firm. Posts trust deposits and disbursements, runs three-way reconciliation, files state-bar exception reports. `:admin` tier on TRUST-ACCT and `:manage` on TIME-BILLING. Reports to the firm's controller (Accounts Receivable function).
Reviews flagged conflict checks, approves waivers, declines representation, maintains ethics-wall configuration. `:admin` tier on INTAKE-CONFLICT and read-only across the rest of the practice.

Runs daily operations of the firm. Broad operational read across all modules; `:manage` on intake-conflict and matter-mgmt for case opening / closing administrative work. No approval authority on prebills or trust exceptions.
Triages and remediates SoD violations. Tunes the toxic-combination ruleset; reads entitlement catalog and provisioning events to chase mitigation paths.

Real estate agent representing the seller. Authors listings, schedules tours, opens transactions on accepted offers, and shepherds the transaction through close. Manages the seller as a CRM contact; reads inbound CRM leads to qualify listing prospects. Permission bundle: re-brok-agent-ops:manage (the agent works the listing lifecycle), crm-acct-mgt:manage (their seller's contact record), crm-lead-mgt:read (qualifying inbound interest).

Real estate agent representing the buyer. Works inbound CRM leads, schedules tours of others' listings for their prospects, and opens transactions on accepted offers as the buyer-side agent. Primary write surface is on CRM leads; reads other agents' listings and works the buyer side of transactions. Permission bundle: crm-lead-mgt:manage (the agent works the lead lifecycle), re-brok-agent-ops:manage (writes the buyer side of transactions + tours), crm-acct-mgt:read (their prospect's contact context).

Mid-to-large brokerage role specializing in transaction file management and the broker compliance handoff. Reads the agent-side transaction record, authors and tracks disclosures, manages the broker's compliance review queue. Does not author listings or tours. Permission bundle: re-brok-agent-ops:manage (transactions + disclosures from the agent side), re-brok-brokerage-ops:manage (compliance review + commission tracking), clm-repository:read (contract reference for non-standard transaction terms).

The licensed broker legally responsible for the brokerage's regulatory compliance and trust-accounting. Cross-functional: oversight responsibilities span sales activity supervision, transaction compliance review, commission disbursement, and audit response. Admin tier on both RE-BROK modules; read on CRM contacts for client-relationship oversight. Permission bundle: re-brok-agent-ops:admin (full oversight on agent operations, including every workflow gate via permission_hierarchy), re-brok-brokerage-ops:admin (full broker-level access including commission disbursement and compliance approvals), crm-acct-mgt:read (client-relationship visibility).
IGA platform owner. Full admin across all IGA modules; authoritative voice on entitlement catalog, certification cadence, and connector configuration.
Runs and tunes recertification campaigns. Reads entitlement catalog and provisioning state to scope campaigns; closes campaigns and produces evidence.

Receives service requests, assigns technicians, optimizes the daily route. Primary on dispatch ops; secondary read on installed base and service contracts to confirm coverage and equipment history before assigning.

Performs service in the field. Receives assignments via dispatch records, executes work orders, captures time and materials, closes visits. Read access on installed base to look up equipment history; specific gates to complete work orders and PM cycles.
Runs the service organization. Admin on all three modules: dispatch operations, installed base / PM, service contracts. Approves contract activation, decommissioning, and customer-site changes.
Frontline library staff handling check-out, check-in, holds, fines, and patron account questions. Touches circulation and patron modules daily.
Authors and maintains bibliographic, authority, and holdings records. Manages metadata quality, classification, and authority control.
Manages collection development: orders materials from vendors, renews subscriptions, negotiates e-resource licenses, and coordinates receipt with cataloging.
Assists patrons with research, manages discovery configuration, coordinates interlibrary loan requests, and supports circulation when needed.
Head of the library operation; admin authority across cataloging, circulation, patron, acquisitions, discovery, and interlibrary loan.

PMO / BizOps lead who owns cross-team programs in WORK-MGMT. Coordinates project portfolios, owns escalations, and rolls up OKR progress from linked work_items. Primary on TASK-EXEC, secondary on GOALS-OKR for visibility into the strategic-alignment surface.

Default IC seat — assigned work_items, files updates, may author automations within their projects. Primary on TASK-EXEC, secondary read access on GOALS-OKR so they can see the OKR context for their work.

Most-cited cross-functional WORK-MGMT persona (Workfront / Asana / Wrike marketing buyer). Runs campaign projects with creative review workflow. Primary on TASK-EXEC, secondary read on GOALS-OKR for campaign-to-marketing-OKR alignment.

Owns an objective; commits KRs and links them to work_items for progress rollup. Cross-functional by construction (Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Operations leaders all do this). Primary on GOALS-OKR, secondary read on TASK-EXEC. IC-tier on the OKR module (manage + explicit commit gate) since OKR-Owners aren't OKR-module admins.
IT operations persona responsible for SaaS discovery, sanctioning, optimization, and reclamation across the SMP-DISCOVERY-OPT module. Reads renewal context from SMP-RENEWAL.

Procurement persona responsible for the SaaS renewal pipeline, vendor relationships, and contract coordination in SMP-RENEWAL. Reads the application/usage view from SMP-DISCOVERY-OPT to size renewals.
Cross-module SMP administrator under ITAM. Full admin on both SMP-DISCOVERY-OPT and SMP-RENEWAL; owns the SaaS portfolio holistically.
Frontline operator on the IT Service Desk. Triages incidents and service requests, consults the knowledge base, and routes work to engineers. Bundle uses :manage on primary modules.
Manages the Service Desk function. Admin-tier on operational ITSM modules, oversees SLA compliance and queue health, approves escalations and major-incident bridges.
Owns change-and-release management. Chairs the CAB, approves changes, coordinates change windows with incident and problem owners.
Curates the IT knowledge base. Drafts and publishes articles, retires stale content, reads incident / problem context to harvest new KB candidates.
